pairsWith.noteUz: Ogohlantirishlar (buyruq mayli) coursebook 70-bet 1-mashq va 71-bet qoida-buyruqqa; predloglar coursebook 71-bet 6-mashqqa; might/could coursebook 70-bet 1b mashqqa mos keladi.

scanNote:
WORKBOOK 10-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (42-bet). Yuqorida to'q sariq yorliqda 'UNIT 10', yonida katta qora 'Stick to the Rules!'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Vocabulary':
1) 'Read the warnings from parents to their children and fill in the missing verbs.' Qiya: 'put, touch, climb, look, use, come'. 6 SURAT va PUFAKLAR: 1 (yo'l chetidagi bolalar) 'Make sure you ...... right and left before crossing the road.' 2 (maktabdan qaytayotgan qizlar) 'Always ...... straight home from school.' 3 (qizcha) 'Never ...... sharp scissors when I'm not around.' 4 (basseyndagi bola) 'Never ...... your head under the water when I'm not with you.' 5 (dori javoniga qarayotgan bola) 'Don't ...... any of the bottles in the medicine cabinet.' 6 (o'yin maydonchasida tirmashayotgan bola) 'Don't ...... too high on the climbing frame.'

O'NG USTUN:
2) 'Fill in the correct preposition from the list.' Qiya: 'around, with, to, from, in, of, on, away, at'. 1 Always turn off electrical equipment when it's not ...... use. 2 Don't eat ...... bed. You might get mice in your room! 3 Don't play ...... those scissors. You might cut yourself. 4 You shouldn't be rude ...... people. It's impolite. 5 We went ...... a day trip yesterday. 6 Stay away ...... people you don't know. They might be dangerous. 7 The professor went to the woods in search ...... rare plants. 8 You should put a fence ...... your garden to stop your dog from escaping. 9 We have fitted safety gates ...... the top and bottom of the stairs to make the house safer for our kids. 10 Please put the magazines ...... when you finish reading them.
• 'Grammar':
3) 'Match the prompts to the pictures, then make sentences about what might/could happen to each person, as in the example.' 1 fall into / pool; 2 scald / himself; 3 score / goal; 4 drop / shopping; 5 fall off / horse; 6 go / prison. 6 RASM: A [3] futbolchi to'p tepyapti; B otda chopayotgan chavandoz; C sudda o'g'ri va sudya; D basseyn chetida yugurayotgan qiz; E xarid sumkalari ko'targan ayol (sumka yirtilyapti); F plitadagi qozonga qo'l uzatayotgan bola. 1 ...He might score a goal.... 2-6 bo'sh.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '42'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the warnings from parents to their children and fill in the missing verbs: put, touch, climb, look, use, come.
exercises.instructionUz: Ota-onalarning bolalariga ogohlantirishlarini o'qing va tushib qolgan fe'llarni qo'ying: put, touch, climb, look, use, come.
exercises.explanationUz:
OGOHLANTIRIShLAR - BUYRUQ MAYLI
  (coursebook 71-bet qoidasi).

  Make sure you LOOK right and
    left - o'ngga-chapga qara
  Always COME straight home -
    to'g'ri uyga kel
  Never USE sharp scissors -
    o'tkir qaychi ishlatma
  Never PUT your head under the
    water - boshingni suv ostiga
    solma
  Don't TOUCH any of the bottles -
    shishalarga tegma
  Don't CLIMB too high - juda
    baland chiqma


⚠ BUYRUQ MAYLI:

  Tasdiq: FE'L (Look! Come!)
  Inkor: DON'T + fe'l / NEVER + fe'l
  Kuchaytirish: Always / Never /
  Make sure you ...


⚠ 'WHEN I'M NOT AROUND':

  = men yo'g'imda.


⚠ 'A MEDICINE CABINET':

  = dori javoni.


⚠ 'A CLIMBING FRAME':

  = tirmashish uchun konstruksiya
  (o'yin maydonchasida).

items.sentence: Make sure you ___ right and left before crossing the road.
items.uz: Yo'ldan o'tishdan oldin albatta o'ngga va chapga qara.
Maktabdan har doim to'g'ri uyga kel.

items.sentence: Never ___ sharp scissors when I'm not around.
items.uz: Men yo'g'imda hech qachon o'tkir qaychi ishlatma.

items.sentence: Never ___ your head under the water when I'm not with you.
items.uz: Men yoningda bo'lmaganimda hech qachon boshingni suv ostiga solma.

items.sentence: Don't ___ any of the bottles in the medicine cabinet.
Don't ___ too high on the climbing frame.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct preposition from the list: around, with, to, from, in, of, on, away, at.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan to'g'ri predlogni qo'ying: around, with, to, from, in, of, on, away, at.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR (coursebook 71-bet
  6-mashq).

  not IN use      - ishlatilmayotgan
  eat IN bed      - yotoqda
  play WITH       - ... bilan
    o'ynamoq
  rude TO people  - odamlarga qo'pol
  go ON a day trip - bir kunlik
    sayohatga
  stay away FROM  - ... dan uzoq
    turmoq
  in search OF    - ... ni qidirib
  a fence AROUND  - atrofida
  AT the top and bottom - tepasi
    va pastida
  put AWAY        - yig'ishtirib
    qo'ymoq


⚠ 'ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT':

  = elektr jihozlari.


⚠ 'MICE':

  = sichqonlar (mouse ning
  ko'pligi).


⚠ 'IMPOLITE':

  = odobsiz (im- + polite).


⚠ 'SAFETY GATES':

  = xavfsizlik to'siqlari (zina
  uchun).


⚠ 'TO STOP SB FROM + V-ING':

  = ... qilishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik.

items.sentence: Always turn off electrical equipment when it's not ___ use.
items.uz: Elektr jihozlari ishlatilmayotganda har doim o'chirib qo'ying.

items.sentence: Don't eat ___ bed. You might get mice in your room!
items.uz: Yotoqda ovqat yema. Xonangda sichqon paydo bo'lishi mumkin!

items.sentence: Don't play ___ those scissors. You might cut yourself.
items.uz: U qaychi bilan o'ynama. O'zingni kesib olishing mumkin.

items.sentence: You shouldn't be rude ___ people. It's impolite.
items.uz: Odamlarga qo'pol bo'lmasligingiz kerak. Bu odobsizlik.

items.sentence: We went ___ a day trip yesterday.
Stay away ___ people you don't know. They might be dangerous.
items.uz: Notanish odamlardan uzoq tur. Ular xavfli bo'lishi mumkin.

items.sentence: The professor went to the woods in search ___ rare plants.
items.uz: Professor noyob o'simliklarni qidirib o'rmonga bordi.

items.sentence: You should put a fence ___ your garden to stop your dog from escaping.
items.uz: Itingiz qochib ketmasligi uchun bog'ingiz atrofiga panjara qo'yishingiz kerak.

items.sentence: We have fitted safety gates ___ the top and bottom of the stairs to make the house safer for our kids.
items.uz: Uyni bolalarimiz uchun xavfsizroq qilish uchun zinaning tepasi va pastiga xavfsizlik to'siqlari o'rnatdik.

items.sentence: Please put the magazines ___ when you finish reading them.
items.uz: Jurnallarni o'qib bo'lgach, iltimos, yig'ishtirib qo'ying.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the prompts to the pictures, then make sentences about what might/could happen to each person, as in the example. 1 fall into / pool 2 scald / himself 3 score / goal 4 drop / shopping 5 fall off / horse 6 go / prison. Pictures: A footballer kicking a ball; B rider on a galloping horse; C thief in court with a judge; D girl running by a pool; E woman with shopping bags (a bag is tearing); F child reaching for a pan on the stove. Example: A - 3: He might score a goal.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalarni rasmlarga moslang, so'ng har bir kishiga nima bo'lishi mumkinligi haqida might/could bilan gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 fall into / pool 2 scald / himself 3 score / goal 4 drop / shopping 5 fall off / horse 6 go / prison. Rasmlar: A to'p tepayotgan futbolchi; B chopayotgan otdagi chavandoz; C sudda o'g'ri va sudya; D basseyn chetida yugurayotgan qiz; E xarid sumkalari ko'targan ayol (sumka yirtilyapti); F plitadagi qozonga qo'l uzatayotgan bola. Namuna: A - 3: U gol urishi mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
MIGHT / COULD - EHTIMOL
  (coursebook 70-bet 1b mashq).

  might/could + fe'l = ... ishi
  mumkin (ehtimol).

  A → 3 score a goal (futbolchi)
  B → 5 fall off the horse
    (chavandoz)
  C → 6 go to prison (o'g'ri, sud)
  D → 1 fall into the pool (yugurish)
  E → 4 drop the shopping (sumka
    yirtilyapti)
  F → 2 scald himself (qozon)


⚠ 'FALL INTO' vs 'FALL OFF':

  fall INTO the pool - ichiga
    tushmoq
  fall OFF the horse - ustidan
    yiqilmoq


⚠ 'TO SCALD ONESELF':

  = qaynoq suv bilan kuyib olmoq
  (33-betda ham bor edi).


⚠ 'TO GO TO PRISON':

  = qamoqqa tushmoq (artiklsiz).


⚠ 'THE SHOPPING':

  = xarid qilingan narsalar.

D - girl running by the pool (1 fall into / pool)
pairs.right: She might fall into the pool.

F - child reaching for the pan (2 scald / himself)

patterns.exampleUz: Men yo'g'imda hech qachon o'tkir qaychi ishlatma.

patterns.exampleUz: Yo'ldan o'tishdan oldin albatta o'ngga va chapga qara.

patterns.exampleEn: Don't play with those scissors. You might cut yourself.
